cash_breakdown.item: Holding-company bank deposits with original maturity over 3 months

cash_breakdown.item: Residual group bank balances and cash outside holding company
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Residual cash is inferred from consolidated cash less company standalone cash/deposits; operations are mainly PRC manufacturing and depots, with no fast upstreaming proof.
cash_breakdown.reason: Potentially available after operating needs, but lower detachability than parent-level cash.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: All interest-bearing bank and other borrowings are deducted at 100%.
cash_breakdown.reason: Unsecured bank loan and bills discounted with recourse are financing liabilities.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Reserved from detachable funds; estimate approximates 1.5 months of 2023 cash operating costs for a cyclical manufacturer with inventories and receivables.
cash_breakdown.reason: Cash needed to keep factories, depots, inventory procurement and working capital operating.

cash_breakdown.item: Tax, remittance, FX and distribution friction reserve
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Conservative reserve for moving cash, converting currencies and distributing funds across jurisdictions.
cash_breakdown.reason: Not a reported liability, but deducted because cash ownership and remittance path are not fully disclosed.

profit_quality.assessment: Main denominator uses the median of 2021-2023 free cash flow after operating capital expenditure, then applies a 0.55 haircut for container-cycle volatility and the 2023 cash-flow downturn.
adjustments: Excluded the idea of capitalizing cash interest income from detachable funds into the operating-business denominator.
Used net operating cash flow less segment capital expenditure additions as the pre-haircut cash profit proxy: 2021 USD 189.815m, 2022 USD 40.814m, 2023 USD -41.537m; median USD 40.814m.
Applied a cycle and conversion haircut because 2023 revenue fell sharply to USD 382.470m, net operating cash flow was USD -20.809m, and segment result fell to USD 10.203m.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: 2021-2023 operating cash flow was USD 212.194m, USD 64.406m and USD -20.809m; capital expenditure additions were USD 22.379m, USD 23.592m and USD 20.728m.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Cyclical manufacturing profits and weak 2023 working-capital conversion; haircut keeps the denominator numeric but conservative.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Three-year aggregate operating cash flow exceeded aggregate parent net profit, but the latest year turned negative due to inventories, receivables and payables movements.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Maintenance versus growth capex is not split; used three-year median segment capital expenditure additions as a conservative recurring reinvestment proxy.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 2023 working capital consumed cash through inventory increase, receivable increase and payable decrease; this is reflected in using actual operating cash flow and the 0.55 haircut.
